dateline: Arlington/Toronto — BTS closed a sold-out two-night AT&T Stadium run in Arlington (Aug 15-16); V disclosed on an Aug 12 Weverse Live that he's being treated for hearing loss while Jungkook revealed a shin injury; 'SWIM' ties 'Butter' for BTS's longest-ever Hot 100 run at 20 weeks; next stop: Toronto Rogers Stadium (Aug 22-23)
heroHeadline: Day 4,814: BTS Closes Arlington Stand as V Discloses Hearing Loss, Jungkook Reveals Shin Injury
heroSubtitle: August 18, 2026 is Day 4,814 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS closed its sold-out two-night ARIRANG World Tour stand at AT&T Stadium in Arlington (Aug 15-16) with a 25-song Night 2 set that swapped in 'Butterfly' and 'The Most Beautiful Moment in Life Pt. 2' for Night 1's 'Others' and 'Permission to Dance,' per setlist.fm and Yahoo/WFAA. On Aug 12, a joint Weverse Live carried notable health news: V disclosed he's being treated for hearing loss in his right ear, a condition he says worsened during his military service, while Jungkook revealed he's nursing a shin injury (on the verge of a stress fracture) from the tour's North American leg, per the Korea Herald and GMA Network. Both continued performing through the Arlington shows. Chart-wise, 'SWIM' tied 'Butter' for BTS's longest-ever Hot 100 run at 20 consecutive weeks (No. 91, chart dated Aug 15), while parent album 'ARIRANG' logged its own 20th consecutive week on the Billboard 200 (No. 14) — a record run for a K-pop album. The tour advances next to Rogers Stadium in Toronto (Aug 22-23), BTS's first Canadian shows since 2018, then Chicago's Soldier Field (Aug 27-28).
